items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: That was with Ellington, Nat Cole, Sarah, the Marie Bryant Dancers. It was the first big package show.

ctx.x: You were in the hospital when?

Oh, let's see, we did the big show in '51. A lot of people could remember that. That was with Ellington, Nat Cole, Sarah, the Marie Bryant Dancers. It was the first big package show. And then I became sick with tuberculosis, so that took a couple of years out, and I went back with Sarah. Sarah just held the job for me, no matter who played. She wanted me back, you know.
